description: ol-reserved-word (issue #113): `define repeat ... end` redefines `repeat`, a keyword (C19 in spec/grammar.md), even though the reader accepts it lexically in name position here. Issue #838 dropped the `namespace: "reserved"` param -- one code, one meaning, `params: { name }` only (spec/error-model.md:125,132-141). Its sibling reserved-word-define-primitive pins a Core PRIMITIVE at the same slot, and the pair now differ only in the name, which is the point: the learner sees one sentence either way.
